# Augmented Intelligence

> Augmented Intelligence publishes concise, rigorous work on human+AI collaboration: applied studies, methods, verdicts and case reports where artificial intelligence augments professional judgment, with an emphasis on medicine, clinical operations and research workflows.

Published by Auggie Health Inc. · open access (CC BY 4.0). Every article has a permanent Crossref DOI and is free to read and cite.

## Articles
- [The simulator owns truth, the model only narrates: an event-sourced architecture that keeps large language models out of canonical patient state in clinical simulation](https://auggie-health-inc.github.io/articles/deterministic-clinical-simulation-llm-narration/index.html)
